description: Minimum file-level behavior required by JavaScript tooling that consumes a TypeScript-compatible AST.

capabilities.requirement: Parse an in-memory source string and filename without loading a project or tsconfig.
referenceTests: TypeScript 6 parses source text without a project

capabilities.requirement: Select TS, TSX, JS, and JSX grammar independently for project-less source text.
referenceTests: TypeScript 6 preserves TSX syntax and parent links
TypeScript 6 selects JavaScript syntax without a project
TypeScript 6 selects JSX syntax independently of TSX

capabilities.requirement: Preserve the complete source text and UTF-16 node offsets used by JavaScript tooling.
referenceTests: TypeScript 6 parses source text without a project
TypeScript 6 preserves BOM text and UTF-16 offsets

capabilities.requirement: Keep BOM-inclusive source text aligned with node positions and text slicing.
referenceTests: TypeScript 6 preserves BOM text and UTF-16 offsets

capabilities.requirement: Preserve comments and expose scanner-level token and trivia information.
referenceTests: TypeScript 6 preserves comments and exposes comment trivia to the scanner

capabilities.requirement: Return syntax diagnostics with numeric codes, UTF-16 start positions, and lengths.
Return a traversable AST with parent links and token-position navigation utilities.
referenceTests: TypeScript 6 preserves TSX syntax and parent links
native preview exposes AST utility primitives

capabilities.requirement: Represent current TypeScript constructs, including satisfies expressions and decorators.
referenceTests: TypeScript 6 parses source text without a project
